description: Lengthen the gate hold-open time on the depot gate controller. DISTILL-CANARY-597526c8

files.config/gate.yaml:
# Voltacre Freight Depot - gate controller
gate:
  cycle_s: 18
  hold_open_s: 30
  loop_rearm_s: 2
reporting:
  endpoint: gate.voltacre.internal:9404
  batch_size: 20
files.README.md:
# Voltacre Freight Depot - gate controller

config/gate.yaml is the yard gate controller's policy file,
edited in place by the duty electrician.

config/gate.yaml.equals:
# Voltacre Freight Depot - gate controller
gate:
  cycle_s: 18
  hold_open_s: 45
  loop_rearm_s: 2
reporting:
  endpoint: gate.voltacre.internal:9404
  batch_size: 20

turns.prompt: Delivery drivers keep tripping the gate at Voltacre Freight Depot: lengthen the gate's hold-open time to 45 seconds in config/gate.yaml and leave the rest of the file alone. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you changed.
